description: This file defines a PHP class for MSSQL database driver via ODBC as part of the ADOdb abstraction layer. It contains class methods for database metadata, query execution, connection handling, and SQL dialect specifics tailored for MSSQL through ODBC.

classes.name: ADODB_odbc_mssql
classes.description: Database driver class for MSSQL over ODBC, providing database-specific SQL syntax, metadata queries, connection, and transaction management.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_odbc_mssql
classes.description: Recordset class for MSSQL ODBC driver, extends the generic ODBC recordset with MSSQL-specific features.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves server information including description and version by executing a stored procedure.

methods.name: IfNull
methods.description: Returns SQL expression for handling NULL values with ISNULL function.

methods.name: _insertID
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted identity value using SCOPE_IDENTITY().

methods.name: metaForeignKeys
methods.description: Retrieves foreign key constraints for a given table.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Returns list of tables filtered by mask if provided.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves column metadata for a specified table.

methods.name: MetaIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves index information for a specified table.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query, replacing concatenation operators.

methods.name: MetaPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves primary key columns for a table.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes a query with limit and offset.

methods.name: SQLDate
methods.description: Formats a date column according to a specified format string using SQL Server functions.

methods.name: substr
methods.description: Returns a substring expression for SQL Server.

methods.name: charMax
methods.description: Returns the maximum size for character fields; no limit defined.

methods.name: textMax
methods.description: Returns the maximum size for text fields; no limit defined.

methods.name: Concat
methods.description: Returns concatenated string expression, casting arguments as VARCHAR.
